title: Business Domains and the Gold layer
description: The core of FMD is one shared machine: one set of pipelines, one configuration database, one Landing Zone, one Bronze and one Silver lakehouse, described in how data moves through FMD. That machine is deliberately business-agnostic. It ingests, hashes, cleanses and historises whatever entities you register, and it has no opinion at all about what "a customer" or "an order" means.
